dct_description_sm: "Entered according to act of Congress in the year 1857 by R.F. O'Connor in the ... Southern District of New York."
Contributors: Golden, T.; O'Connor, R. F.; Weingartner, A.
Hand colored to emphasize town (township) boundaries and areas.
Includes local business directories, 6 insets of urban places (including Herkimer and Little Falls), vignettes of prominent buildings, and bust of President G. Washington (in compass rose).
LC copy imperfect: Brittle, shellacked, the 2 southern sheets halved to enable folding, water-stained on cloth backing.
Originally printed on 4 sheets with outlines different from the present 4 sheets.
Publication statement: Little Falls, N.Y. : R.F. O'Connor, 1859.; New York : Engrav'g & print'g of A. Weingartner's Lith'y.

The northern half of the map shows numbered survey tracts, some with owner's name; the southern half shows rural buildings and householders' names. The city insets show building coverage, lot/tract lines, and owners' names.
